_comment: One-tap fixes for permissions a run reports as missing (POST /projects/<name>/run -> missing[].label, from PermissionNeeds.Kind). permission: the xscript.android.permission constant; /eval runs `from xscript.android import permission\n_result = permission.request(permission.<permission>, 1)` ("1": already granted). captureRequest: POST /capture/request instead. Clients keep their own copy (Web IDE editor-model.js, VS Code missingPerms.ts, PyCharm MissingPerms.kt + bundles); each one's tests compare it with this file, and the Android unit tests compare the labels with PermissionNeeds.Kind.
